description: AliExpress Affiliate link generation (Portals) via official method aliexpress.affiliate.link.generate on the signed TOP/IOP gateway. Product search/detail already live in aliexpress-partner; this checklist tracks promotion link issuance only. Checked 2026-10-14.

capabilities.title: Convert product or store URLs into promotion links with tracking_id
capabilities.blocker: Official method documented (promotion_link_type, source_values, tracking_id) at https://developer.alibaba.com/docs/doc.htm?articleId=45804&docType=2&treeId=674 — adapter wiring and live receipt not yet in this repo. Reuse signing from lib/commerce/aliexpress-affiliate.mjs; do not invent a second signer.

capabilities.title: Support promotion_link_type 0/1/2 (normal, search, hot) as documented
capabilities.blocker: Needs live verification per app permission set after link_generate works.

capabilities.title: Bind links to the publisher tracking_id from the same app
capabilities.blocker: tracking_id must come from the Portals account; do not hard-code foreign IDs.

capabilities.title: Reverse storefront mtop sign for link APIs
capabilities.applicabilityReason: Forbidden under anti-bot-boundaries.md; official sync API only.
